Horizon Zero Dawn – Attenborough Style

A parody-style David Attenborough voiceover for Horizon Zero Dawn, delivered with wit and precision by Guy Harris.

‹›

Another epic collaboration with IGN

Getting the email from IGN was a real treat. I'm often on their site scouting for new games, trailers and voiceover opportunities. As someone who grew up on the ZX Spectrum, C64 and PS3, lending my Attenborough-style narration to this trailer was pure joy.

We nailed the tone quickly. They had a vision for a nature documentary-style parody, and we had a laugh crafting something unique. If you liked this, have a listen to my other Attenborough projects, such as the Turkish Airlines spoof or Cracking Ice, a frosty nod to Attenborough’s iconic delivery.

What is Horizon Zero Dawn?

Horizon Zero Dawn is an open-world RPG developed by Guerrilla Games. It follows Aloy, a skilled hunter living in a post-apocalyptic world ruled by machines. Her journey to uncover her origins and reclaim the Earth is packed with cinematic sequences, perfect for a nature-meets-gaming-style narration.

And let’s face it... those giant robot giraffes are practically crying out for an Attenborough-style breakdown.

Want a voice like this?

If you’re looking for a realistic David Attenborough voiceover, I’ve got you covered. Whether it’s for a trailer, a documentary spoof, or a branded explainer, I bring the tone, pace, and polish you’d expect.

Scripts must stay respectful, no profanity, no claiming to be him. But if you’ve got something fun and creative in mind, drop me a line and let’s discuss it. Or try out the new Attenborough Script Generator to bring your idea to life in a few clicks.

Searching for an explorer?

Need something with gravitas and a dash of humour? I can provide narration in the style of Sir David Attenborough, perfect for trailers, spoofs, explainer videos, and more. Have a listen to more examples or get in touch for a bespoke quote.

This is not affiliated with Sir David himself. But it’s delivered with deep respect for his tone, pace and style. No profanity. No AI cloning. Just good, clean parody.
